definition only partially frozen.
ANGLE ON EVIL ASSOCIATE MUSTAFA. He is terrified and sweaty,

autonomic functions were shut down,

...ex-Irish assassin. His trademark?
Around PATTY O'BRIENS WRIST is a charm bracelet.

tiny keepsake on every victim he
kills. Scotland Yard would love to

evidence.

(heavy Irish accent)Yes, they're always after me lucky

(angry)

(through suppressed
laughter)

concerned that these children will
steal his lucky charms which arefoodstuffs fashioned into various

(pause)

miniature models of factories.

makes decorative hand-painted theme
plates for collectors.

Some plates, like the Gone With The

percent, but, as with any investment,

I've been frozen for thirty years,

essence a sophisticated heat beam

(pleasantly surprised)

One-hundred billion dollars.

FRAU FARBISSINA
Remember when we froze your semen,

weren't coming back to try and make
you a son so that a part of you would
live forever?

Yes.
FRAU FARBISSINA
Well, after a few years, we got sort
of impatient. Dr. Evil, I want you
to meet your son.

My son?

Yes.

Scott!

Hi.

Evil.

I have a son! I have a son!
Everyone, I have a son!
(gesturing to globe)
Someday, Scott, this will all be
yours.

I haven't seen you my whole life and

text:
Technicians lead a half-asleep Austin to a screened area, where only his feet and head are visible. He's washed off with a series of hot-water jets. FEMALE ANNOUNCER (on PA) Cleansing complete. FEMALE ANNOUNCER (PA) Evacuation com... He begins PEEING again. A little LONGER. Then in short staccato BURSTS. The it STOPS. Pause. Two DRIPS. FEMALE ANNOUNCER Evacuation... (waiting) Complete! The cryogenic state of Austin Powers is now completed.

frozen for thirty years.

frozen, Austin. The cold war's over.

will finally pay for their crimes
against the people,
hey Comrades?

We won, Austin.
AUSTIN
Groovy. Smashing! Good on ya!
(to Gilmour)
Nice tie. Yea capitalism!
COMMANDER GILMOUR
Mr. Powers, the President's very
concerned. We've got a madman onthe loose in Nevada.
BASIL EXPOSITION
It's Dr. Evil.
AUSTIN
When do I begin?
BASIL EXPOSITION
Immediately. You'll be working with
Ms. Kensington.
AUSTIN
You mean Mrs. Kensington?
BASIL EXPOSITION
No, Austin, Mrs. Kensington has long-since retired. Ms. Kensington is
her daughter.
VANESSA KENSINGTON, Mrs. Kensington's daughter, beautiful,
mid-Twenties, English, enters. She is wearing a very
conservative, business pantsuit. Her hair is up and she
wears glasses. Austin's breath is taken away.She sets down a huge stack of files.
BASIL EXPOSITION
Vanessa's one of our top agents.
AUSTIN
(out loud, to himself)
My God, Vanessa's got a smashing
body. I bet she shags like a minx.
How do I tell them that because of
the unfreezing process, I have no
inner monologue?
(pause)
I hope I didn't say that out loud
just now.
There is an uncomfortable SILENCE.
VANESSA\nMr. Powers, my job is to acclimate\nyou to the Nineties. You know, a\nlot's changed since 1967.\nAUSTINWell, as long as people are still\nhaving promiscuous sex with many\nanonymous partners without protection,\nwhile at the same time experimenting\nwith mind-expanding\ndrugs in a consequence-free environment, I'll be sound as a\npound.\nVANESSA\nMy mother's told me all about you.\nAUSTIN\nIf it's a lie, goddamn her. It it's\nthe truth, goddamn me.\n(pause)\nGod, I hope that's witty. How's\nyour mum?\nVANESSA\nMy mother's doing quite well, thank\nyou very much.
BASIL EXPOSITION
Yes, well...Agent Kensington willget you set up. She's very dedicated.
Perhaps, a little too dedicated.
(aside to Austin)
She's got a bit of a bug up her ass.
Good luck, Austin, the world's
depending on you.
AUSTIN
Thank you, Exposition.
BASIL EXPOSITION
Oh, and Austin&emdash
AUSTIN
Yes?
BASIL EXPOSITION
Be careful.
AUSTIN
Thanks.
